message.feywild.autumn_pixie_cookie: [Autumn Pixie]: Oho- do come see me again, darling!
message.feywild.autumn_pixie_name: [Autumn Pixie]: Thank you very much, darling! I bet you'd like to know my real name, don't you?
message.feywild.autumn_pixie_follow: [Autumn Pixie]: Going for a walk? I'd like to come with you!
message.feywild.autumn_pixie_stay: [Autumn Pixie]: It feels so homely here! A good place to stay while you're away, darling.
message.feywild.autumn_pixie_summon: [Autumn Pixie]: Darling! What took you so long?
message.feywild.autumn_pixie_dismiss: [Autumn Pixie]: If this makes you happy...farewell...
message.feywild.autumn_pixie_ability_on: [Autumn Pixie]: I'll start harvesting for winter is coming!
message.feywild.autumn_pixie_ability_off: [Autumn Pixie]: Yes, enough! We've put so much into this harvest, don't you agree it's time to rest?
message.feywild.spring_pixie_cookie: [Spring Pixie]: Come play with me again in the Feywild!
message.feywild.spring_pixie_name: [Spring Pixie]: Oh! Can I give you a nickname too? My real name's a secret though! I'll never tell! Never ever!
message.feywild.spring_pixie_follow: [Spring Pixie]: You'll take me on a adventure with you? This is gonna be great!
message.feywild.spring_pixie_stay: [Spring Pixie]: This place looks pretty- I'll wait for you here! Oh! What's that?
message.feywild.spring_pixie_summon: [Spring Pixie]: Oh! Where am I? Who are you? Are you taste?
message.feywild.spring_pixie_dismiss: [Spring Pixie]: Bah, you're so boring! I thought we where friends?
message.feywild.spring_pixie_ability_on: [Spring Pixie]: Hehe! Spring is the season of Love, After all!
message.feywild.spring_pixie_ability_off: [Spring Pixie]: Aww, you're such a bummer! Fine I'll stop! But... can we make them fly next?
message.feywild.summer_pixie_cookie: [Summer Pixie]: Hm- perhaps you won't be as boring as I thought...!
message.feywild.summer_pixie_name: [Summer Pixie]: How dare you nickname me like I'm some sort of magician's pet! I'll never tell you my real name! Hmph!
message.feywild.summer_pixie_follow: [Summer Pixie]: You need me to accompany you? Sigh...fine!
message.feywild.summer_pixie_stay: [Summer Pixie]: Don't make me wait too long! Hmph!
message.feywild.summer_pixie_summon: [Summer Pixie]: How dare you summon me like I am some sort of magicians pet?
message.feywild.summer_pixie_ability_off: [Summer Pixie]: I shall decide when to cease...and that moment...is now!
message.feywild.winter_pixie_name: [Winter Pixie]: A nickname...? I can't even remember my real name.
message.feywild.winter_pixie_follow: [Winter Pixie]: Can't you go out on your own...?
message.feywild.winter_pixie_stay: [Winter Pixie]: Such inconvenience... I'll stay here...
message.feywild.winter_pixie_summon: [Winter Pixie]: Such inconvenience...why did you summon me mortal?
message.feywild.winter_pixie_dismiss: [Winter Pixie]: So annoying...Winter shall come for you...
message.feywild.winter_pixie_ability_on: [Winter Pixie]: I'll gather part of their soul...you can have their scrap...
message.feywild.winter_pixie_ability_off: [Winter Pixie]: I will cease...could you offer your soul instead?
message.feywild.mandragora_cookie: [Mandragora]: Want to look for flowers together someday?
message.feywild.mandragora_name: [Mandragora]: That's a wonderful name! I feel really appreciated! Thank you!
message.feywild.mandragora_stay: [Mandragora]: Ill take care of your garden! You go on your adventure. Be careful...
message.feywild.mandragora_dismiss: [Mandragora]: But...Who will look after the flowers?
message.feywild.mandragora_ability_on: [Mandragora]: Oh? You want to hear me sing?
message.feywild.bellsnickel_cookie: [Bellsnickel]: I said I wanted something to read not eat...
message.feywild.bellsnickel_name: [Bellsnickel]: Pah! You can call me what ever you want! I still won't listen! Hehehe~
message.feywild.bellsnickel_follow: [Bellsnickel]: Making me walk all this way!!
message.feywild.bellsnickel_stay: [Bellsnickel]: Finally can read my book! I thought they'd never leave
message.feywild.bellsnickel_summon: [Bellsnickel]: Wha? I was reading a book...
message.feywild.bellsnickel_dismiss: [Bellsnickel]: Pah! Books are better then people anyways...
message.feywild.bellsnickel_carry_stuff: [Bellsnickel]: Making me carry all this stuff...Oh My back! My back...
message.feywild.bellsnickel_trade: [Bellsnickel]: Humph! This stuff is as old as I am.
message.feywild.bee_mount_cookie: [Bee Knight]: When you need me Ill be [sigh]...there!
message.feywild.bee_knight_cookie: [Bee Knight]: When you need me Ill be [sigh]...there!
message.feywild.bee_mount_name: [Bee Knight]: Is this name for me or my noble steed?
message.feywild.bee_knight_name: [Bee Knight]: Is this name for me or my noble steed?
message.feywild.bee_mount_follow: [Bee Knight]: Lets go on a grand quest!
message.feywild.bee_mount_stay: [Bee Knight]: Are we off duty? Alright! Let's go!
message.feywild.bee_mount_ability_off: [Bee Knight]: Are you sure you will be [sighs]...okay without me?
message.feywild.bee_mount_summon: [Bee Knight]: On my honor as a bee knight, I will protect you!
message.feywild.bee_mount_attack: [Bee Knight]: Making me carry all this stuff...Oh My back! My back...

quest.feywild.sprite_root_start_descript:
Hello there! As one of the enchanting new features of the $(#8867DB)Enchanted Edition of the Feywild Lexicon$(), this book contains within it an imprint of a $(#8867DB)specially-conjured spiritedly companion$()! This little pixie will assist you with navigating the Lexicon, teaching you $(#60D8E6)the ways of the Fey$(), and answering each and every one of your questions.

Would you like to personalize your copy of the book by telling her your name?
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_01_start_desc:
Let us begin by asking a question: $(#60D8E6)what are fey?$() Perhaps you’ve noticed that sometimes, things are not quite as they seem? That you might be a little extra lucky during your day; or when you can't find your left sock? These are some of the harmless tricks often played by the fey. 
All fey come from a magical place of whimsy called $(#60D8E6)the Feywild$(). 
I'll teach you more about us, starting with how to $(#60D8E6)summon and communicate with the fey$().

To get started, you will need some magical $(#60D8E6)fey dust$(). This shouldn't be too hard to get, as most $(#60D8E6)fey$() will gladly give you some when you $(#86DB67)offer$() them something sweet to eat. A favorite for many of them are $(#86DB67)cookies$()! 

Alternatively, if you're a more violent type, you could instead force them to relinquish their $(#60D8E6)fey dust$() to you by $(#EFBF04)besting one in combat$(), which should be fine as well. 

Or, if you would prefer a more mundane approach, you can obtain it by $(#CE2803)smelting$() $(#60D8E6)fey gems$() that you can find while $(#CE2803)mining$() underground. 

 For those who are more keen to $(#319DFC)play with death$(), you can try sneak to a fey tree and $(#319DFC)break a cracked log$() to obtain a fey gem.

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Obtain 1 Fey Dust$()
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_01_complete_d:
Well done! Hopefully it wasn't too hard to get.
You will need this in order to make your first $(#60D8E6)summoning scroll$(), which will allow you to $(#8867DB)guide the essence of a fey to the mortal realm$(). But let’s take this one step at a time.
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_02_start_desc:
To write a $(#60D8E6)summoning scroll$(), you will need special $(#60D8E6)ink$() which has been enhanced by the power of a $(#CE2803)mandrake$().

To get your first $(#CE2803)mandrake root$(), you’ll need to $(#8867DB)infuse$() a $(#8867DB)poisonous potato$() with $(#60D8E6)fey dust$(). Plant it in some $(#CE2803)fertile farmland$() and let it grow nice, big, and loud until it’s ready for the picking. Don’t forget to protect your ears!

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Obtain 1 Mandrake$()
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_02_complete_d:
Oof... So this is why you don't spoil your potatoes, huh? At least we can set that part behind us.

 - The sprite leaps up in the air happy at your accomplishment -
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_03_start_desc:
Now then. If you take a $(#60D8E6)glass bottle$(), squeeze out an $(#60D8E6)ink sac$() into it, and then add a little bit of $(#CE2803)mandrake$()...Or just throw in the whole thing, why not? Make it nice and squishy; don’t sweat the details! 

Go on, try it.

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Obtain 1 Fey Ink$()
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_03_complete_d: Isn’t this satisfying? With my help, perhaps you'll become the best $(#8867DB)potion maker$() ever! Onto the next step.
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_04_start_desc:
You are so close! The last step is easy: grab some $(#60D8E6)paper$() and dip the tip of a $(#60D8E6)feather$() into the $(#60D8E6)fey ink$() so you can write the $(#8867DB)incantation$()!

Once you do that, you’ll be $(#8867DB)summoning Fey$() in no time!

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Obtain 1 Empty Summoning Scroll$()
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_04_complete_d: Yes, yesss~! Now that you have this, all you need to do now is envision the fey you want to summon, $(#8867DB)offer$() the scroll to the $(#60D8E6)Fey Altar$() and... why are you staring like that? Are we forgetting something? Do you even have an altar at your disposal?
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_05_start_titl: Do You Want to Build an Altar?
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_05_start_desc:
Oh dear. Well, grab some $(#60D8E6)smooth stone$() and make the $(#60D8E6)Fey Altar$() already, silly!

The altar needs to resemble one of $(#60D8E6)the great Fey Lords$() that presently rule $(#60D8E6)the Feywild$(). The monarchs of $(#60D8E6)the Seasonal Courts$() are $(#86DB67)Oberon$(), $(#CE2803)the Ashen Lord$(), and $(#319DFC)Queen Mab$()... Oh, there’s also $(#EFBF04)Queen Titania$().

For the statue to channel any magic, it will need to hold a $(#60D8E6)fey gem$() within its core.

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Obtain 1 Fey Altar$()
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_05_complete_d:
I've got to hand it to you, that's one beautiful altar! Wouldn't it be nice to have one of yourself someday? ...Well, a fey can dream.

Now it’s time for you to make an important $(#60D8E6)decision: you must choose which Pixie you will summon!$()
 Keep in mind that $(#60D8E6)the season your pixie belongs to will determine their powers and personality$(), so choose wisely. 

$(#60D8E6)So: what is your favorite season?$()
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_06_start_titl: A little spring in your step
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_06_start_desc:
D’aww, you want to $(#8867DB)summon$() a $(#86DB67)Spring pixie$()? So, you’d like your chosen pixie to be cheerful and bubbly? All “Tee-hee!” and “Let's go play!” without end? Hehehe, alright.
For that, your saccharine new companion is going to need a lot of energy! You’ll need your $(#60D8E6)summoning scroll$(), a $(#60D8E6)fey gem$() to keep the magic in, and then you’ll need something to please $(#86DB67)Oberon$()...Hm. 

A nice, sugary $(#86DB67)cake$(), a $(#86DB67)flower of any kind$(), and some fluffy $(#86DB67)wool$() should do the trick!

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Obtain 1 Spring Pixie Summoning Scroll crafted with the Fey Altar$()
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_06_complete_t: Too Much Spring in Your Step
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_06_complete_d:
Congratulations on summoning a $(#86DB67)Spring pixie$()! You are surely going to have more fun, playtime, and sweets in your new life than you can possibly fathom!

To celebrate your progress, this book will offer you a free $(#8867DB)Pixie Orb$(). This artifact allows you to $(#8867DB)communicate with and instruct the Fey that you summon$(), and it will be of great use to you in your future encounters with $(#60D8E6)the Fey$()!

Make sure it stays on your person at all times! If you ever require a spare or replacement, you can $(#CE2803)craft$() one at a $(#60D8E6)Fey Altar$() with (2)$(#8867DB)ender pearls$(), (2)$(#60D8E6)fey gems$(), and $(#60D8E6)fey dust$().
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_07_start_desc:
Ah, so you want to $(#8867DB)summon$() an $(#CE2803)Autumn pixie$()? Those domestic pixies are really something. They do love everything homely, so why not?

Will you be a dear and fetch your $(#60D8E6)empty summoning scroll$() and your brightest $(#60D8E6)fey gem$()? You’ll also need something that will delight $(#CE2803)the Ashen Lord$()...Mm. 

My suggestion is to go fetch a $(#CE2803)pumpkin$() and a $(#CE2803)mushroom$(); for the final item, a $(#CE2803)hoe$() of any kind should do.

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Obtain 1 Autumn Pixie Summoning Scroll crafted with the Fey Altar$()
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_07_complete_d:
Congratulations on summoning an $(#CE2803)Autumn pixie$()! You can count on your charming new caretaker companion to handle each and every one of your needs!

To celebrate your progress, this book will offer you a free $(#8867DB)Pixie Orb$(). This artifact allows you to $(#8867DB)communicate with and instruct the Fey that you summon$(), and it will be of great use to you in your future encounters with $(#60D8E6)the Fey$()!

Make sure it stays on your person at all times! If you ever require a spare or replacement, you can $(#CE2803)craft$() one at a $(#60D8E6)Fey Altar$() with (2)$(#8867DB)ender pearls$(), (2)$(#60D8E6)fey gems$(), and $(#60D8E6)fey dust$().
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_08_start_desc:
Oh? You want to $(#8867DB)summon$() a $(#319DFC)Winter pixie$()? That does run a chill down my spine. - The little sprite shivers. - They are morbid and cold-hearted, but if that's something you like…~
You will need your $(#60D8E6)empty summoning scroll$(), a $(#60D8E6)fey gem$(), and something to appease that frostbitten $(#319DFC)Queen Mab$()...Ah, I know.

$(#319DFC)Rotten flesh$() and $(#319DFC)skeleton bones$() will suit someone as frightful as her, and we’ll top it off with a $(#319DFC)snowball$() for that extra chill.

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Obtain 1 Winter Pixie Summoning Scroll crafted with the Fey Altar$()
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_08_complete_t: Close Encounters of the Frozen Kind
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_08_complete_d:
Congratulations on summoning a $(#319DFC)Winter pixie$()! This macabre little pixie is going to make your heart run cold, and you will surely love her for it!

To celebrate your progress, this book will offer you a free $(#8867DB)Pixie Orb$(). This artifact allows you to $(#8867DB)communicate with and instruct the Fey that you summon$(), and it will be of great use to you in your future encounters with $(#60D8E6)the Fey$()!

Make sure it stays on your person at all times! If you ever require a spare or replacement, you can $(#CE2803)craft$() one at a $(#60D8E6)Fey Altar$() with (2)$(#8867DB)ender pearls$(), (2)$(#60D8E6)fey gems$(), and $(#60D8E6)fey dust$().
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_09_start_desc:
You want to $(#8867DB)summon$() a $(#EFBF04)Summer pixie$()? Those pixies are arrogant and hot-headed; are you sure you want to put up with that?

If you’re absolutely certain, then you already have your $(#60D8E6)empty summoning scroll$(). Now you need a $(#60D8E6)fey gem$() to hold in the magic, and then... something to appease $(#EFBF04)Queen Titania$().

A $(#EFBF04)melon$() and a $(#EFBF04)honeycomb$() sounds like the right place to start, and then you should throw in in a $(#EFBF04)golden sword$() to quench their lust for battle.

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Obtain 1 Summer Pixie Summoning Scroll crafted with the Fey Altar$()
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_09_complete_d:
Congratulations on summoning a $(#EFBF04)Summer pixie$()! Good luck with that.

To celebrate your progress, this book will offer you a free $(#8867DB)Pixie Orb$(). This artifact allows you to $(#8867DB)communicate with and instruct the Fey that you summon$(), and it will be of great use to you in your future encounters with $(#8867DB)the Fey$()!

Make sure it stays on your person at all times! If you ever require a spare or replacement, you can $(#CE2803)craft$() one at a $(#60D8E6)Fey Altar$() with (2)$(#8867DB)ender pearls$(), (2)$(#60D8E6)fey gems$(), and $(#60D8E6)fey dust$().
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_10_start_desc: You lost your $(#8867DB)Pixie Orb$()? You can $(#CE2803)craft$() one at a $(#60D8E6)Fey Altar$() with (2)$(#8867DB)ender pearls$(), (2)$(#60D8E6)fey gems$(), and $(#60D8E6)fey dust$().
quest.feywild.sprite_quest_10_complete_d: You lost your $(#8867DB)Pixie Orb$()? You can $(#CE2803)craft$() one at a $(#60D8E6)Fey Altar$() with (2)$(#8867DB)ender pearls$(), (2)$(#60D8E6)fey gems$(), and $(#60D8E6)fey dust$().
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_root_start_de:
How dare you summon me like I'm some sort of magician's pet!
You'd better know your place... Hmph!
I demand you tell me your name!
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_01_start_desc:
Just my luck that I end up with someone like you...
– The pixie looks you up and down with a disdainful look on her face. –
Not much muscle, though that might be normal for your kind... And that look... You might not be the brightest.

...Hey! Stop gasping! I'm not insulting you. I'm assessing you! There's a difference!
If you want to be part of the $(#EFBF04)Golden Seelie Court$(), you'd better look the part; I can't present you as my champion before $(#EFBF04)Queen Titania$() when you look like this!

Go on; present yourself to me when you are properly attired in a $(#EFBF04)golden chestplate$().
Don't look at me like that – I'm not paying for it!
The audacity... – The pixie rolls her eyes. –

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Obtain 1 Golden Chestplate.$()
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_01_complete_d:
...Oh, you're back? ...Alright, let's take another look at you!
– The pixie looks at you with less disdain; you can detect a small smile. –
Turn around... once more... again!
– The pixie laughs at that. –
I guess it's an improvement. You are worthy of my insults now!
Here, this should finish your look as my champion.
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_02_start_desc:
Before we seek an audience with $(#EFBF04)Queen Titania$(), you will first have to prove your worth to me!
So – a $(#EFBF04)trial of combat$()! You will fight...
– The pixie thinks deeply about what mortally wounding foe you will have to face. –
...A golem! Yes – an Iron Golem!
If you survive, I will deem you worthy of being in my presence.
If not, well... – The pixie giggles before realizing you're still there and clears her throat. – Uh, ahem... Off you go!

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Land the killing blow on an Iron Golem.$()
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_02_complete_d:
What a battle! I had a few good laughs at your struggles, but you pulled through in the end!
It's not much, but it's something. Ahah, so funny! Ahem...
What? You expected a reward? Your reward is being in my presence, of course!
A reward... the audacity! You can have the scraps, I guess...
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_03_start_desc:
So, you have some skill with a sword; that's nice and all, but do you have wits?!
To prove yourself worthy of being my servant and protector, you should... present to me... a $(#60D8E6)Bee Nest$()!
Yes! Preferably with the bees still inside! We require more buzzing steeds for our cavalry...
The Queen will be pleased with my offering! Be it the bees or your mortal corpse... – The pixie giggles. –
...Uh, ahem; hop along and don't get stung!

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Obtain a Bee Nest. You will need the Silk Touch enchantment for this.$()
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_03_complete_d:
That was amazing! Are you okay? ...I mean, I hope those stingers didn't hurt too much!
Or is that your normal face? In which case, maybe you were better off getting stung...

These will be perfect offerings for our Queen.
We're always in need of steeds for our Bee Knights!
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_04_start_titl: May the Odds Be Forever in My Favor
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_04_start_desc:
Maybe you're not so useless after all!
The $(#EFBF04)Summer Court$() is constantly under attack by a group of raiders who hunt down our kind to grind us into dust – or worse, steal our sacred honey!
We – and by we, I mean you, of course – should take down those $(#60D8E6)Pillagers$()!
Then, with you as my Champion, we can share our victory with the Queen, and I will be forever in her favour! – The pixie is pleased with her own genius plan. –
Perfect! So... why are you still standing here? Go! Now!

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Land the killing blow on 8 Pillagers.$()
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_04_complete_d:
You actually did it! – The pixie restrains herself from embracing you. –
Ahem; you did an admirable job, and I hope you will continue to slaughter my enemies as my very own champion!
– She circles happily around you. –
$(#EFBF04)Queen Titania$() is pleased with your offerings and your victory for the $(#EFBF04)Golden Seelie Court$(); as their new champion, you are presented with a special reward!
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_05_start_desc:
Ah – my Champion!
– The pixie appears to be rather vibrant today. –
I'm in a good mood? I'm not normally?
I'm just pleased with my accomplishments of late!
Yes, yes, you had some part in that as well!
We should report this to one of the royal $(#EFBF04)Bee Knight$() emissaries.
Let's go summon one right now!

Grab your scroll, fey ink, a bee's nest, and those beautiful gifts I gave you. Yes, I am talking about the sword and the melon!

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Summon a Bee Knight.$()
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_05_complete_d:
Why isn't she leaving? She should be leaving. We should be alone, just the two of us... – The pixie blushes. –
Not like that! Like friends, I mean... Like a Master and her champion! Hmph!
Though... I wouldn't mind... being friends.
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_06_start_desc:
Champion! Something awful has happened...!
The $(#319DFC)Winter Court$() has tried to assassinate our Queen to claim her $(#EFBF04)Crown$() as their own!

Why do you look so confused? Oh, right – where to begin...
Each seasonal Court has a ruler who wears a $(#60D8E6)Fey Crown of Power$(), which gives them control over one of the seasons.
If the $(#319DFC)Winter Court$() had succeeded, the seasons would have been thrown into chaos!

We need information, and I know of one being that hoards information and knowledge: a $(#319DFC)Bellsnickel$()!
Let's go $(#86DB67)summon$() one to interrogate!

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Summon a Bellsnickel.$()
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_06_complete_d:
Did you get any information on the $(#319DFC)Winter Court$()?
What are you standing around for, then? You hold him down; I will check his bag!
We need to succeed, or $(#EFBF04)Queen Titania$() will have our heads!
– The pixie starts digging through the Bellsnickel's bag of books. –
… 'Productive Bees!' ...This could be useful, but that's not what we're here for!
… 'Making Farming a Delight.' Really!?
… 'The Mystical Arts of Agriculture' – Ugh – What is this $(#CE2803)Autumn$() and $(#86DB67)Spring$() pixie nonsense?!

Aha!
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_07_start_desc:
This must be it! “The True Balance of Power” by Lady M.
– The pixie starts leafing through its pages. –
I see, I see! – Okay, let me explain!
A long time ago, even before the current fey courts existed, there was a war between the $(#FFB0DF)Light$() and $(#8867DB)Shadow$() Courts, which the $(#FFB0DF)Light$() Court eventually won.
The $(#FFB0DF)Light$() Court banished the leader of the $(#8867DB)Shadow$() Court and then split into the seasonal courts. According to this book, $(#EFBF04)Queen Titania$() was chosen to supervise them all. But that never happened, and now whoever holds the most crowns holds the reins.
So that's their plan! The $(#319DFC)Winter Court$() wants to seize control over all seasons!

Ugh, what to do? I need to consult one of the elders. We need to summon a $(#EFBF04)Summer Tree Ent$().

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Summon a Summer Tree Ent.$()
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_07_complete_t: To Say Something in Old Entish
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_07_complete_d:
– The pixie and the Tree Ent hold a very, very long conversation, with the pixie doing most of the talking and the Ent most of the listening. –
– After many hours of this, she returns to your side, tired and with dark circles under her eyes. –
Whew – I'm beat... Ents take soooo long to say just about anything!
– The pixie rests on your head, her arms and legs dangling over the sides. –
Champion! Our leafy ally will relay this message to the Queen and make sure we are well protected.

I will conjure us the biggest meal ever! My treat! ...Why are you looking at me like that? Stop it! I just wanted to show you my gratitude!
Besides, we've been through so much together...
Would you stop it! Just accept my generosity! Hmph!
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_08_start_desc:
– After some bickering, you and your pixie enjoy a (delightful) meal. While cleaning up, the Tree Ent reappears and speaks to your companion. She promptly returns to your side, visibly shaken and panicking. –

Champion... I have received orders from $(#EFBF04)Queen Titania$()!

We... we are to defeat $(#319DFC)Queen Mab$() and bring an end to her evil reign.

Let's prepare everything we need, but don't summon her yet! She is powerful, and we need to prepare!
– For the first time ever, you notice that she is extremely sad and worried. –

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Obtain a Summoning Scroll for Queen Mab.$()
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_08_complete_d:
– The pixie paces left and right while muttering aloud. –

$(#319DFC)Queen Mab$()!? Is this for real?
I mean, I don't even know if we should... It's so dangerous!
Would it be okay if we don't fight $(#319DFC)Queen Mab$()?

We'll be exiles forever... but... I'd rather spend eternity being hunted down, as long as it's with you!
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_09_start_desc:
– The pixie clings to you, sobbing. –
I'm sorry! I tricked you into making a contract by telling me your name! I just wanted a champion of my own!
I'm sorry! If we make it, I'll tell you my name, and you won't be bound any longer! I promise!!

So, Champion... no... my dearest friend! I will leave this choice to you. No matter what you choose, I will remain by your side!

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Land the killing blow on Queen Mab.$()
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_09_complete_t: But It Cannot Just End There
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_09_complete_d:
You defeated her! You actually did it! No, we did it, together!
– The pixie hugs you tightly. –
As promised, I'll tell you my name...
– The pixie whispers her name in your ear. You expected the contract to burn, but instead it gains a new glow, with a different kind of magic. –
Since you're no longer bound to a contract, you're free to go now...
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_10_start_desc:
I didn't expect you to stay... W-why did you stay?
What...? – The pixie turns red and waves her arms around in panic. – ...We're... friends?
– The pixie pauses at that before smiling happily. –
The audacity! Friends! Hmph... You wish!
A human and a Fey can't be friends, not forever... your lifespan is too short...
What? You want to become one of us? You will?

It won't be easy. You need an elytra to grant you the gift of flight, combined with the magic of a pixie tiara to shed your mortality.

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Obtain a Summer Pixie Wing Tiara.$()
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_10_complete_d:
You and your pixie friend return home to the $(#EFBF04)Summer Court$(). As you arrive at the $(#60D8E6)Mother Tree$() in the $(#EFBF04)Golden Seelie Fields$(), a company of $(#EFBF04)Bee Knights$() awaits your arrival. They cheer for the $(#EFBF04)Summer Court$()'s newest stars!
You kneel before $(#EFBF04)Queen Titania$(), ready to be knighted and to receive your everlasting reward: a Magical Touch from the Queen herself... Embracing the magic of the Fey, you become one of them – leaving behind your mortal life to join their realm... simultaneously their Champion and their Friend.
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_11_start_desc:
$(#EFBF04)-End of the Summer Pixie Quest-$()

Thank you for playing Feywild!
quest.feywild.summer_pixie_11_complete_d:
$(#EFBF04)-End of the Summer Pixie Quest-$()

Thank you for playing Feywild!
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_root_start_de:
Such an inconvenience... Why did you summon me, mortal?
This ordeal will most certainly lead to your premature demise. But then, maybe we can be friends...
Care to tell me your name?
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_01_start_desc:
Greetings, mortal... Your arrival is as expected.
– The pixie speaks in a monotone, with barely any inflection in her voice. –
Meaning...? Eventually, you would end up in $(#319DFC)the arms of Winter$() anyway, as it is inevitable.
Now that you've stated your name, your soul belongs to us...
If you don't want us to collect your soul at this moment in time, then you should prove your worth to us.
I wouldn't want to overload your severely lacking mortal brain, so a simple task will suffice.
Some souls still roam the mortal world. Kill these zombies and provide us with some $(#60D8E6)rotten flesh$() as proof of your accomplishment... eight should do...

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Obtain 8 Rotten Flesh.$()
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_01_complete_d:
You seem rather efficient at collecting these... Maybe I can assign you a purpose after all.
Wasn't I clear...? Your soul belongs to us... and so you either provide us with more, or we collect yours...
But were you to meet an early demise, I could be your friend on the other side.
Everything has a silver lining...
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_02_start_desc:
Now that your soul has been initiated into the $(#319DFC)Winter Court$(), we should keep it safe...

Obtain a $(#319DFC)Soul Lantern$(), and I can make sure your soul is stored safe and sound.
Your soul is already withering.
You'd better hurry...

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Obtain a Soul Lantern.$()
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_02_complete_d:
You made one... Hurray...
– The pixie gives a rather deadpan cheer as she throws grave dust into the air; it slowly drifts down around you. –
Oh, mortal... You shouldn't be so fearful...
– The pixie pats you on the head. –
There, there... you have done well.
Your soul is safe with me... as long as you provide, of course.
I don't want you to become the next pile of grave dust we celebrate an initiation with...
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_03_start_desc:
– The pixie lets out another sigh. – You're still alive...? Why do you keep persisting, mortal?
Though... as much as I would like to be your friend, your presence in the mortal realm is required. Maybe we should postpone our friendship... and strengthen your soul by keeping it bound to this plane.

In exchange for other souls, we could strengthen yours...

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Land the killing blow on 8 Pillagers.$()
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_03_complete_d:
You collected them all? I am so... impressed. I guess I made this for nothing.
– The pixie has made you a tombstone and dug a fresh grave. –
It does look comfortable... I envy you. It looks like a nice resting place.
– The pixie momentarily considers taking a nap on your grave. –
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_04_start_desc:
Your soul-collecting skills are impeccable... You have the makings of a great $(#319DFC)Reaper$().
$(#319DFC)Reapers$() are $(#319DFC)Queen Mab$()'s greatest champions. To become one, you need more experience with death.
– The pixie calls forth a Reaper's Scythe as she grins. –

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Land the killing blow on 3 Wither Skeletons.$()
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_04_complete_d:
– The pixie nods approvingly. –
Those wounds and that pale complexion make you look like a Reaper.
Too bad your face doesn't match.
Wear this.
– The pixie puts a mask on your head and nods approvingly. –
Why can't you always look like this? I can almost tolerate your existence now...
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_05_start_desc:
Reaper!
Something big has happened. Your end is here...
Now is the time to put your destiny as a Reaper into motion.

...Oh, you're confused? Fine, I'll explain... – The pixie takes a cold, deep breath. Holds it. –
...Nope. Too much effort.

One of the $(#319DFC)Bellsnickels$() from the Court can get you up to speed.
Here's a list of what you need to call one forth...

I need a rest.
– Once more, the pixie falls asleep on your grave. –

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Summon a Bellsnickel.$()
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_05_complete_d:
No! I don't want to converse with him...
Fine!
– The pixie reluctantly moves towards the $(#319DFC)Bellsnickel$(). –
Hello, Uncle...

No. I don't want an Antique Atlas... So dusty...
A Book on Dragon Mounts... that's an efficient way to meet an early demise...
Creatures and Beasts? What separates one from the other?
– You sigh, and the pixie clears her throat. –
Anyway...
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_06_start_desc:
I see.
So there was an assassination attempt on our Queen by the Summer Court.
– The pixie ponders for a second. –

Seems like you're fulfilling your destiny after all... No, not by dying! That can wait! As a summoner!

If you could summon one of the $(#EFBF04)Summer Court's Bee Knights$(), we could interrogate them. I'll get my supplies...
– The pixie seems very happy. –

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Summon a Bee Knight.$()
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_06_complete_d:
– The part that followed was not suitable for our Minecraft audience. –
See... never trust a $(#EFBF04)Summer$() fey. $(#EFBF04)Queen Titania$() has always looked for a reason to get rid of $(#319DFC)Queen Mab$() and claim $(#319DFC)Winter's Crown$() for her own. We should inform $(#319DFC)Queen Mab$().
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_07_start_desc:
Are you pondering what I'm pondering, mortal?
– The pixie looks shocked. –
What? No!! That's even too morbid for me...

I meant that we should summon a $(#319DFC)Winter Tree Ent$() to inform $(#319DFC)Queen Mab$().

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Summon a Winter Tree Ent.$()
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_07_complete_d:
– After conversing for a very long time with the Winter envoy... –
$(#319DFC)Queen Mab$() is willing to return your soul if you are willing to vow your life to the $(#319DFC)Winter Court$().
For the first time, you notice a subtle hint of sadness in her eyes.
– She pats you on the head. –
You are a good person. Someone should tell you that sometimes.
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_08_start_desc:
$(#319DFC)Queen Mab$() has decreed that it's time to shift the balance of the $(#60D8E6)Fey Courts$().
The $(#319DFC)Winter Pixie$() is hesitant to tell you $(#319DFC)Queen Mab$()'s orders. Her next words are barely audible...

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Obtain a Summoning Scroll for Queen Titania.$()
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_08_complete_d:
Well, that's the summoning scroll out of the way...
– The pixie rests on your head, her arms and legs dangling over the sides. –
You are my final resting place, mortal. Let's go back to your comfortable grave... we might as well get used to it...
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_09_start_desc:
Your destiny awaits: you will face $(#EFBF04)Queen Titania$(), or your soul will be forever ours...
But do not worry. I'll be your friend either way... I've grown quite fond of you, mortal.
Ready to meet your demise?
I'll be collecting your soul when it's time... See you on the other side...

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Land the killing blow on Queen Titania.$()
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_09_complete_d:
Mortal, defeating $(#EFBF04)Queen Titania$() is a feat I never thought you were capable of. This deserves a great reward.

– The pixie leans close to your ear and whispers her name. –
Now we are equal, mortal.
– She sprinkles some more grave dust... –
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_10_start_desc:
I know I said we are equals, so why are you still here? We're friends? Such an inconvenience...
Don't expect me to carry your mortal body around forever. I should stop calling you mortal? You want to be one of us? One of the Fey?

Okay.

Then you should obtain an elytra, and with the magic of the Pixie Tiara, we can rid you of your mortal coil.

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Obtain a Winter Pixie Wing Tiara.$()
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_10_complete_d:
– The pixie pats you on the head. –
I told you that you were a good being...
– You return to $(#319DFC)Queen Mab$(); though uncertain of the consequences of this action, it is now in her hands. –
Your life and freedom are yours once more... But after your time with the pixie, you've come to embrace the presence of death.
You accept the touch of the Fey and leave your mortal life behind.
You fly to the $(#319DFC)Frozen Retreat$() with your friend as the $(#319DFC)Winter Court$()'s newest $(#319DFC)Soul Reaper$().
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_11_start_desc:
$(#EFBF04)-End of the Winter Pixie Quest-$()

Thank you for playing Feywild!
quest.feywild.winter_pixie_11_complete_d:
$(#EFBF04)-End of the Winter Pixie Quest-$()

Thank you for playing Feywild!
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_root_start_de:
Where am I? Who are you? Are you tasty? Let's go on an adventure!
You wanna play? ...I'm hungry!
What's your name?
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_01_start_desc:
I can't believe I found an adventurer! We're going to be the bestest of bestest friends!
Now I can go on an adventure too! Explore the world, taste new colors, meet weird creatures, try out new kinds of food!
Oh – the food! I can't wait!

What is that? A cloud? No, wait – cotton candy!

I wanna touch it! Lemme touch it!

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Pet a sheep (with an empty hand) together with your pixie.$()
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_01_complete_d:
...It doesn't taste very sweet. Oh – it's a sheep? It's so fluffy!
Oh, and look! It has so many friends!

– The pixie points upwards as the sheep nervously bleats. –
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_02_start_desc:
It must be lonely without its friends all the way up in the sky! Wait – it can't fly!?
But flying is the best thing there is! Let's find a way to make it fly! Oh! I know – let's use some fey dust on it!

– The pixie puffs out her chest. – I'm so smart, ehehee!

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Apply Fey Dust to a Sheep 3 times.$()
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_02_complete_d:
You made it fly! It must've been so happy!
...Maybe we should've taught it how to land; it's broken now...
Luckily, I captured the spirits of all the sheep you brutally murdered before they were taken by the Winter Court!

Now we can play with our fluffy friends from the sky whenever we want!
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_03_start_desc:
Let's have a race to see who can pop the dandelion fluff the fastest!
I used to play that all the time with my pixie friends of the Spring Court!
The flowers here are so small, so let's combine the little dandelions with fey dust to make bigger ones!

And then we play the game!
And... and... oh!
Aaaand the loser has to play with the other all night long!
Ready? Go!

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Pop the fluffy part of a Giant Dandelion 3 times.$()
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_03_complete_d:
Hey, no fair! – Huff, puff... – You cheated! Hmph!

Now I win by default, so you've got to play with me some more!

– You lose track of time as you play with the pixie all through the night. ...Was it just one night? Or two? Or more...? –
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_04_start_desc:
You want to know more about the different Courts? Well, you chose the best Court, because we're by far the most fun!
Nothing like those arrogant Fey of the Summer Court who think they rule the Feywild! And the Winter Court is just scary... – The little pixie shivers. –

Which reminds me: now that you belong to the Spring Court, we should make an offering to Prince Oberon!
Maybe you can bake some of those delicious human-made cakes and bring two of them to me? ...The ones made with sugar, of course – not humans, duh!

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Gift 2 Cakes to your pixie.$()
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_04_complete_d:
What's that smell? What are you making? The cakes for Prince Oberon?!
No-no-no, this treasure is mine...! Let's eat it quickly before Prince Oberon finds out!

– The tiny pixie plunges her face into the cake! –

Phew – I'm stuffed! I think I might explode! Huff, puff... Got any more?
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_05_start_desc:
I can't believe you ate both cakes! Now we don't have an offering for Prince Oberon...

Well, Oberon loves music, so maybe we can get someone to sing for him. And I know the bestest singer!

Can you summon a mandragora for me? They have the nicest voices!

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Summon a Mandragora.$()
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_05_complete_d:
Wow, she sounds amazing! You're the best! – The little pixie hugs you. – Thanks for being my friend!

– As you listen to the gentle lullaby of the mandragora, you feel something tugging at you. Destiny? Purpose? Somehow, it feels like a reminder of who you once knew you were meant to be... But why go back? This is so much fun! –

– The melody is undercut by a now-familiar voice. –

...Who was this offering for again?
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_06_start_desc:
The Autumn Court can be really fun too! You can fly through all the coloured leaves! Play in the rain! Play tag with shroomlings! Oh – and they have delicious mushroom stew... – Gasp! – We should summon one!

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Summon a Shroomling for fun! (Not for stew.)$()
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_06_complete_d:
– You enjoy your time with the pixie and the Shroomling. It feels like days of chasing them have gone by – dancing in the rain and running through leaves. –
– As you're about to lose track of time and everything that was once important, you remember that all good things must come to an end. –

– The pixie notices the change in your outlook. –

Are you getting bored? Maybe it's time we move on. But why...? Aren't you having fun? Don't you want to keep playing with me?
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_07_start_titl: It Doesn't Have to Be a—
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_07_start_desc:
Did something happen while we were out playing? The Courts are getting restless; let's find out what's going on!

– The little pixie flutters off without you... and comes back after a short while in a panic. –
Oh no – something terrible has happened! Queen Titania has been assassinated! Oberon must be devastated...
Oh well; none of our business anyway, right?

...Ehehehee, stop being so serious! – You're hit by a tiny snowball. – Who cares about all of that right now? Do you want to build a—

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Hit the pixie with a snowball before she can finish that sentence.$()
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_07_complete_d:
– The pixie eats a mouthful of fluffy snow as you hit her right in the face. –
Well, fine! What do you want to do...?!

– The pixie starts rattling off all kinds of pixie games, each one wilder than the last. As she talks, you start to get that feeling that you might have lost track of time again... –

...W-what? If I keep playing, an Enderman will come get me? That's not funny – hmph!
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_08_start_desc:
Prince Oberon must be very upset; we should go comfort him and bring him some kind of gift!

Well, you ate the cakes, and I forgot what that other thing we tried was, so this one's gotta do the trick! Hmm...

Oh, I know: we could get some of the delicious golden honey from the Summer Court!
But bee careful, hehe – with those Bee Knights patrolling the area! Don't wanna get stung, after all!

I know the greatest guardian who can protect us from the bees: Mr. Grumpy Tree! Let's go summon him.

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Summon a Spring Tree Ent.$()
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_08_complete_d:
– You summon the “Great Protector, Mr. Grumpy Tree,” who is apparently a Herald of Prince Oberon. –
– You feel the air shift as his roots touch the ground and the leaves blow in the wind; his voice booms like a tree trunk crashing onto a bed of rocks. –

“My little pixie friend...
“What have you done?
“You've been playing to no end, so now reckoning has come.
“You've kept our hero busy with games,
“And you've no way left to shirk Prince Oberon's blame.
“You'd best appease him before it's too late;
“Perhaps some freshly baked cakes will his appetite sate?”

– The pixie whispers: – I told you, you shouldn't have eaten those cakes...
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_09_start_desc:
Ughh, I don't wanna go all the way to the Blossoming Wealds to meet Prince Oberon...!

Also, apparently the developer is slacking off and hasn't made it yet? Whatever that means.

You're a summoner – summon him! It saves time, and then we can play some more!

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Obtain a Summoning Scroll for Prince Oberon.$()
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_09_complete_d:
Oooh, maybe Prince Oberon would like to play with us? He can be It first!

– The pixie grabs the scroll from your hand and draws a doodle on it: you, her, and an odd-looking deer guy playing a game of tag. –
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_10_start_desc:
– It's clear that Prince Oberon is furious from the moment you summon him. –

Oberon! Do you want to play tag with us!?

– The Prince reaches for his spear, making his intent known. Yes, perhaps Oberon IS going to play a game with you... but you somehow doubt that this is the sort of game you're meant to survive. –

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Land the killing blow on Prince Oberon.$()
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_10_complete_d:
Why was he so upset with us? We were just minding our own business and even tried to offer him some kind of present!

I still can't believe we defeated a Sovereign, though. – The pixie giggles. – What're you gonna do with the Tiara?

...Oooh, can we play King and Queen now? I'll be the King, and you'll be the Queen!
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_11_start_desc:
I had so much fun with you, adventurer! Did you have fun with me too?
I'm so happy! I could play with you forever!

I want to fly around with you, dash through leaves, eat stew, annoy bees, and even take another snowball to the face!

Oh, I know what to do with that tiara now! You could use it to make a set of Fey Wings and join me! You'll just need a little bit of pixie magic.

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Obtain the Spring Pixie Tiara.$()
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_11_complete_d:
– You and your pixie friend return home after your adventures, having created and put on the Fey Wings so you can join her in flight. You become drowsy as you settle into bed. –

– What did she mean when she said that...? You think nothing of it and fall asleep. –

– Then the little pixie comes to whisper something into your ear. Her name... no mortal should ever hear her name! You feel your worries melting away as you finally embrace the touch of the Fey... a gift from your friend. –
– Having become one of the Fey, the last breath leaves your former body as you join their Realm, where you can play forever in the Blossoming Wealds. –

– You had the best time ever! –
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_12_start_desc:
$(#EFBF04)-End of the Spring Pixie Quest-$()

Thank you for playing Feywild!
quest.feywild.spring_pixie_12_complete_d:
$(#EFBF04)-End of the Spring Pixie Quest-$()

Thank you for playing Feywild!
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_root_start_de: Darling, what took you so long! I've been waiting for a fine specimen just like you. Would you care to tell me your name?
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_01_start_desc:
Oh my – an adventurer? – The pixie looks you over from top to bottom, as though she is peering into your soul. –
I see...
You won't need that sword while I'm around... well, except maybe as a cooking knife.
Why don't you let me hold on to that sword for you?
– The pixie holds out her hands, and somehow you feel tempted to give up your adventuring days and stay in her warm embrace. –
Aww, don't worry; I'll protect you from now on!

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Gift a sword, preferably not an Iron Sword.$()
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_01_complete_d:
Thank you, darling! You are so adorable; no need to be nervous.
I think I'll feel right at home with you.
As they say: 'Home is where the heart is!'
– The pixie winks at you. –

Just relax; let's make this a nice and comfy place to live in!
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_02_start_desc:
Every home needs good home-cooked meals!
So – let's make some preparations, shall we?
Can't receive guests if you can't prepare a proper meal, after all!
First, we need to craft a Smoker; don't you agree, darling?

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Craft a Smoker.$()
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_02_complete_d:
Wonderful – and you got that so fast! A good cook is defined by their tools, you know!
Goodness, we're all prepared! Maybe I can get you one of those cute aprons! Let me cook our first meal, sweetie. You rest; you've been working so hard!
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_03_start_desc:
Isn't our home coming along nicely!
I wish you wouldn't go on your adventures alone; if you bring me along, I will always be beside you.
But our home also needs a cute pet. How about a dog?
They are very loyal creatures, you know!

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Tame a Wolf.$()
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_03_complete_d:
Aww, it's adorable!
Hey, dog! You'd better keep my darling safe!
Maybe we can make them a small doggie pen? I'll leave the decorations to you!

Poor dog; they seem famished!
You should take good care of 'Dog,' or the Winter Court will claim them.
Maybe you can cook them some dog food?
I think they like cooked beef.
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_04_start_desc:
Dog! Doggie! Come here!
Darling, I made you some food!
Aww, look – they like it!... We can't keep calling them 'Dog' – they need a proper name! Don't worry – you'll never know their real name, so it's fine!

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Give your dog a name.$()
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_04_complete_t: A Dog by Any Other Name
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_04_complete_d:
That's a lovely name!
Would you like to know my name too? I can be anything you like, darling.
Where I'm from, knowing someone's name is like having power over that being.

Ah – you gave me your name?
– The pixie gives you a knowing smile. –
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_05_start_desc:
How are you today, darling?
Do you want to do something for me, to help make me feel more at home?
Aren't you the sweetest? Let me think...! No, all I need is right here!

But I do miss the smell of fresh mushrooms running around in autumn leaves.
Yes, darling! Where I'm from, the mushrooms run around and are quite friendly. Would you like to meet one? We could make use of your summoning skills. Just this once, though... we don't want you getting those adventuring urges again.

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Summon a Shroomling.$()
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_05_complete_d:
Oh wow... I like this one! He is quite spicy.
Don't be jealous; you will always be my favorite.

It's almost like my home – the Eternal Falls.
That is the home of the Autumn Court, yes.
Yes, of course; each season has its own Court!
Why do you think the seasons change here? It's because the Fey fight for dominion over the Feywild!
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_06_start_desc:
Would you like to know more about the Seasonal Courts?

Our Court isn't concerned with the power struggles of the other Courts. We care more about a good home and preparing for when winter comes.
We also give those close to death a peaceful passing and good memories before leaving them to the cold slumber of Winter.
Unlike the other Fey Courts, the throne of the Autumn Court is vacant, though we do have a sovereign of sorts: the Ashen Lord, the oldest of the Tree Ents.
We honor him, since no Autumn Fey is foolish enough to take on the mantle of Autumn Ruler.

I still need to deliver an offering of dyes to the Ashen Lord – to help colour the trees, of course! Can you help me with this, darling?

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Summon a Mandragora.$()
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_06_complete_d:
Do you hear that? The wonderful singing just fills the silence that was there before. And her singing can even make beautiful flowers grow.

Darling, let's gather some of these flowers. We can use them to make dye and bring some color to our house. It could be the start of our very own garden. What a lovely idea! I'll get a vase.
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_07_start_desc:
Hmm, odd. The mandragora's flowers are not as vibrant as they used to be. Maybe something is going on in the Spring Court? And why is it snowing on a sunny day...?

I don't feel so well... something is... amiss with the flow of the seasons.
– The pixie sees you grabbing your adventuring gear. –
No, darling! Why are you falling back into your old habits again?
Let's just stay here... together...
– The pixie turns pale and starts coughing up black ichor. –
...Darling... I... need medicine.

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Gift the pixie a Potion of Healing.$()
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_07_complete_d:
Oh no, you went on an adventure again... for me...
I guessed as much... Can't stop those adventurer's impulses, can I?
– The pixie laughs sadly. –

I, uhm... kinda stole you away from both the Summer and Winter Courts.

Both would have claimed you as their own and then sent you to your inevitable demise... Perhaps I'm not able to stop you from going on your quest, but at least I can give you some nice memories – a good home and good company...
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_08_start_desc:
Something is amiss with our sovereign.
I can hear a voice whispering in the wind that blows through the autumn leaves.
The Ashen Lord... He is in pain.

Let's summon one of the Ents. Maybe they can tell us what is happening.

This... isn't what is supposed to happen...

Your destiny was in my hands, and now it's up to you how you want to shape it...

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Summon an Autumn Tree Ent.$()
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_08_complete_d:
Autumn is the season of change, and much like Spring embraces beginnings, Autumn welcomes endings.

We make sure everybody has a good time and is well prepared for when winter comes! The end may be scary, and that's why most mortals fear us Autumn Fey.

But as you will see, darling, there is beauty near the end.

Let's talk to the ancient one and see what he can tell us.
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_09_start_desc:
Darling... The Ambassador of the Oaks tells me the struggles of the Courts have reached Autumn.

The Crown of the Fey has fallen to the Ashen Lord. Something must have befallen the other Courts' Sovereigns.
– The pixie panics. –
Was I wrong...? Was I wrong to prevent you from reaching your destiny and becoming the hero you were meant to be?

– The pixie sighs, knowing full well what she is about to ask. –

The Ashen Lord needs you, Hero! Can I rely on your skills despite everything I did?

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Obtain a Summoning Scroll for the Ashen Lord.$()
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_09_complete_d:
Oh no, the scroll is dripping with dark magic.
I don't recognize this... but I sense the danger emanating from it.

There must be something amiss with the Ashen Lord.
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_10_start_desc:
I am afraid I might lose you, darling. Can't we just stay at home?
Dog is waiting for us...

Maybe things will turn out differently after all.
– The pixie coughs once more, and more black ichor erupts from her mouth. –

Don't worry about me... nothing a little rest and care won't solve...

Please...

– The pixie faints, and her fate is now in your hands. –

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Land the killing blow on the Ashen Lord.$()
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_10_complete_d:
You did! You did it...
– The pixie looks sad but embraces you in a warm hug. –
Some magic must have taken hold of the Ashen Lord.
He was talking about a corruption and a voice he heard...
A sad end to a sad story... I hope he finds peace in his next iteration.
– The pixie looks at the crown in your hand. –
No, darling – I won't take it; I have no desire for such power.

Let's go home one last time? Please...
– You and your pixie friend return to the warmth of your home. –
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_11_start_desc:
You return to the magic of your home.
You live your life with Dog and the pixie.
For a long time, or maybe longer, you forget your heroic deeds.
One evening, you are cleaning out the attic when the Crown tumbles out from between your old adventuring gear.

– Your pixie appears and lays a hand on your shoulder. –
Your mortal life is close to the end of its span. Soon, the Reapers of the Winter Court will come. There is a way to stay with me forever, as a Fey.

The choice is yours...

$(#60D8E6)Objective: Obtain the Autumn Pixie Tiara.$()
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_11_complete_d:
That night, a Reaper of the Winter Court came.
But it was too late...

The Autumn Pixie embraces you with the touch of the Fey. You accept the sensation – warm and comfortable... your last breath leaves your mortal body.

A small tear falls from her eye as she whispers a name in your ear.
I am yours forever, darling.

You become one of the Fey and leave your adventurous life behind; it was good and full of memories.
'Don't worry,' the pixie says, 'your canine friend will be there too; after all, they tried to protect you... loyal till the end!'
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_12_start_desc:
$(#EFBF04)-End of the Autumn Pixie Quest-$()

Thank you for playing Feywild!
quest.feywild.autumn_pixie_12_complete_d:
$(#EFBF04)-End of the Autumn Pixie Quest-$()

Thank you for playing Feywild!
